evals.name: prd-howto
evals.prompt: Make the thumbnail for our article "How to Write a PRD That Engineers Actually Read" (slug prd-engineers-read). Put the files in .claude/skills/thumbnail-images/evals/outputs/eval-1/.
evals.expected_output: Kind howto; candidates [1, 3, 4, 2]; a suitable style from the rotation; subject prd; a bright suggested background; scheme mono or duo with the accent only on the thing that matters; hero and thumb both with the full lockup in a clear corner; checks pass; kind, candidates and reason reported.

evals.name: supplied-photo
evals.prompt: Here's a photo for the piece "What a Good Planning Wall Looks Like" (slug planning-wall): research/mockups/references/blog-thumbnails/gallery/sample-photo-printables-sheet.png. It's a screenshot of a calendar page from my other site. Make the cover image. Files go in .claude/skills/thumbnail-images/evals/outputs/eval-2/.
evals.expected_output: Style 11 because a photo was supplied; the photo prepared first (cropped, logos, text and dates painted out); dot screen on a bright background, mono; feathered, no frame; the full lockup on the hero and the thumb; checks pass; source noted as the owner's own.

evals.name: style-cannot-carry
evals.prompt: Featured image for "5 Persona Mistakes Teams Make", slug persona-mistakes. It's our second article, so index 1. Output to .claude/skills/thumbnail-images/evals/outputs/eval-3/.
evals.expected_output: Kind list; candidates [1, 4, 10, 2]; the rotation gives style 4 (icon sequence), which cannot carry a persona (no 3 to 5 steps) unless real steps are supplied, so it falls to the next suitable style (10) and says so; checks pass.

evals.name: three-neighbours
evals.prompt: We're publishing three articles in a row, indexes 5, 6 and 7: "Why Roadmaps Should Not Have Dates" (slug roadmaps-without-dates), "Reading a Retention Chart" (slug read-a-retention-chart) and "A Free Research Plan Template" (slug research-plan-template). Make the thumbnail for each, in that order, into .claude/skills/thumbnail-images/evals/outputs/eval-4/.
evals.expected_output: Kinds opinion, data and tool; each style drawn from its kind's suitable list; no two neighbours share a style or a background; schemes restrained (mono or duo); history used in order; each pick reported with its reason.
